message:
During last winter's big storm, I found myself glued to the family group chat as the snow piled up outside. My daughter sent a picture of the kids building a snowman that was taller than my husband, while my son posted a video of the dog trying to catch snowflakes—pure comedy gold. 

Amid the snowball fights and hot cocoa recipes, I reminded everyone to check their emergency supplies and make sure flashlights had fresh batteries. You know, just in case the power decided to join the snowman in hibernation. 

It's funny how a little storm can turn into a cozy gathering place, even if it's just on our phones. What’s your favorite way to stay connected during a storm?
